# Input

`cinnabar:extension/input@0.1.0`

Local control edges, available only with explicit controls authority.

**Grants:** `controls`, except demo-pressed, which needs no grant.

Imported type `event`: [`event`](panel.md#type-event).

## Types

<a id="type-text-event"></a>

### `text-event`

A committed native field value addressed by its declared control ID.

```wit
record text-event {
    id: string,
    value: string,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string` |  |

<a id="type-field-key"></a>

### `field-key`

    shift: bool,
    control: bool,

}

| `super-key` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-field-event"></a>

### `field-event`

A native edit, submission or navigation edge; composition remains host-owned.

```wit
variant field-event {
    change(text-event),
    submit(text-event),
    key(field-key),
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `text-event` |  |
| `submit` | `text-event` |  |
| `key` | `field-key` |  |

Types: [`field-key`](input.md#type-field-key), [`text-event`](input.md#type-text-event).

<a id="type-controls"></a>

### `controls`

One focused input sample; keys and pointer use the host's coordinate and naming contracts.

```wit
record controls {
    seconds: f32,
    focused: bool,
    gameplay: bool,
    panel-open: bool,
    keys-pressed: list<string>,
    keys-held: list<string>,
    events: list<event>,
    pointer: option<tuple<f32, f32>>,
    wheel: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | `f32` |  |
| `focused` | `bool` |  |
| `gameplay` | `bool` |  |
| `panel-open` | `bool` |  |
| `keys-pressed` | `list<string>` | Physical non-repeat edges; pointer buttons use MouseLeft/MouseRight/MouseMiddle. |
| `keys-held` | `list<string>` | Physical keys held this frame, including reserved ones. |
| `events` | `list<event>` |  |
| `pointer` | `option<tuple<f32, f32>>` | Pointer position in the gameplay HUD root's GUI units from its top left, the space of<br>`hud.read-viewport`, while this mod's open panel owns input; none otherwise. A panel's<br>own fitting, such as a `reference_size` scaled to a small window, does not change it. |
| `wheel` | `f32` | Wheel notches this frame while this mod's panel owns input; positive scrolls up. |

Types: [`event`](panel.md#type-event).

<a id="type-selection"></a>

### `selection`

Selects which fields to copy without changing the underlying frame or its event ordering.

```wit
record selection {
    keys-pressed: option<list<string>>,
    keys-held: option<list<string>>,
    events: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `keys-pressed` | `option<list<string>>` | None selects all keys; some(empty) selects none; names select exact matches. |
| `keys-held` | `option<list<string>>` |  |
| `events` | `bool` |  |

## Functions

<a id="demo-pressed"></a>

### `demo-pressed`

```wit
demo-pressed: func() -> bool;
```

True only for the current frame's host-assigned action edge.

<a id="read-controls"></a>

### `read-controls`

```wit
read-controls: func() -> result<controls, string>;
```

Reads this callback's control sample with controls authority and the shared read allowance.

Types: [`controls`](input.md#type-controls).

<a id="read-selected-controls"></a>

### `read-selected-controls`

```wit
read-selected-controls: func(selection: selection) -> result<controls, string>;
```

Reads selected fields from the same current frame, preserving native key order.
Requires controls authority and shares the read-controls callback read budget.

Types: [`controls`](input.md#type-controls), [`selection`](input.md#type-selection).

<a id="read-text-events"></a>

### `read-text-events`

```wit
read-text-events: func() -> result<list<text-event>, string>;
```

Committed single-line native text edits, separate from legacy numeric control events.
Requires controls authority; repeated reads see the same bounded batch in a frame callback.

Types: [`text-event`](input.md#type-text-event).

<a id="read-field-events"></a>

### `read-field-events`

```wit
read-field-events: func() -> result<list<field-event>, string>;
```

Live values coalesce per field between frame callbacks. Submit and navigation retain order.
Navigation includes the modifiers sampled at that key edge; preedit stays host-local.

Types: [`field-event`](input.md#type-field-event).

<a id="reserve-keys"></a>

### `reserve-keys`

```wit
reserve-keys: func(keys: list<string>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Physical key names reserved before the ordinary gameplay router samples them.
